from flask import Flask, request, g
import sqlite3

app = Flask(__name__)
DATABASE = 'gender_aid.db'

def get_db():
    db = getattr(g, '_database', None)
    if db is None:
        db = g._database = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE)
    return db

@app.route('/add_genre', methods=['POST'])
def add_genre():
    genre = request.form['genre']
    aid = request.form['aid']

    query = "INSERT INTO associations (aid, genre) VALUES (?, ?)"

    db = get_db()
    cursor = db.cursor()
    cursor.execute(query, (aid, genre))
    db.commit()

    return 'Genre added!'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run()
